question: What are the most common mistakes small businesses make when approaching large corporations to sell products or services?
transcript_excerpt: Small businesses don't appreciate the size of the company they're approaching and treat large organizations like small ones. Common mistakes include using Gmail accounts instead of professional email, overly simplistic branding and storytelling, and not being clear about their offer and benefits. Because large corporations receive many requests, small businesses must be very precise about why they're different and what value they add.
